steps: Torpedo body: the frame everything mounts to.
Captive 4-40 nuts into the body traps (top cover x4, marker base x3, bottom cover screw D).
Captive 8-32 nuts into the body traps for the servo-holder ears.
Right helix into its cavity in the body through the marker-base opening (bigger than the bearings, so it goes in before its shaft).
Printed torpedo shaft (18T gear end stays below) up through both bearings and the right helix; pin the helix.
Pushing arm onto the shaft top, onto the thrust face.
Cross-pin nut into the pushing arm pocket.
Cross-pin screw through the arm and shaft into the nut.
Torpedo springs onto their guide pins.
Top cover onto the body.
Flat-head 4-40 x 1 screws through the top cover into the captive nuts.
Left helix into the cavity from below, meshing with the right helix (it is bigger than the bearing, so it goes in before its shaft).
Captive 4-40 nut into the marker base for bottom cover screw C.
Marker base up to the body joint face.
Socket-head 4-40 x 1-1/2 screws up through the marker base into the body nuts.
Marker shaft (lobe end down) up through the marker-base bearing into the left helix; pin the helix.
Marker springs onto their guide pins.
Bottom cover onto the marker base.
Bottom cover screw C (4-40 x 2 flat head) into the marker-base nut.
Bottom cover screw D (4-40 x 2-1/2 flat head) through the marker base into the body nut.
Servo holder to the body's rear face.
Socket-head 8-32 x 3/4 screws through the ears into the body nuts.
SER-20XX servo onto its seat with 4 M3 through-bolts.
Servo gear onto the spline (meshes with the shaft gear).
Crossbar arm onto the body keel.
Fork nuts into their recesses (captive nuts before their bolts).
Fork bolts 8-32 x 2-1/2 through the fork and keel into the nuts.
Crossbar captive nuts into the side slots (crossbar screws go in on the robot).
Load the torpedoes through the top cover; twist to lock.
Load the markers up into the bottom cover; twist to lock.
